title: Research Scientist – Molecular Diagnostics
description:
Our Bosch Research team occupies a critical position between academic research and product development, distinguishing us from many other companies. We engage with academia, incubate ideas, advance them to the prototype stage, and collaborate with development teams in our business units to support product development based on our research outcomes. We are seeking a research scientist with a strong academic background, proven industry experience, and a passion for tackling complex, real-world problems in molecular diagnostics.
Our R&D center is located in Sunnyvale, CA, USA. This is in the heart of Silicon Valley in close proximity to Stanford University and UC Berkeley. The candidate will be a key contributor to our research and development efforts, from conceptualization to the creation of novel technologies. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with industry experience who is eager to make a significant impact in the field of molecular sensors and biotechnology.
Responsibilities:
• Identify, incubate, and translate cutting-edge academic research into functional, scalable proof-of-concept technologies in molecular diagnostics and biosensing.
• Lead hands-on development and testing of prototype diagnostic systems, integrating microfluidics, and electrochemical sensing.
• Collaborate closely with internal business units, engineering teams, and external academic partners (e.g., Stanford, UC Berkeley) to transition early-stage research into commercially viable product pipelines.
• Design and execute advanced experiments for single-molecule detection, assay integration, and sample-to-answer cartridge performance.
• Protect innovation through patent filings while contributing high-impact scientific publications and technical documentation.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in biosensors and bioelectronics, advising multidisciplinary teams on technical feasibility, risk mitigation, and system architecture.
• Education: PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Physics, or a related discipline)
• Industry Experience: 3-5 years of previous industry experience in a relevant biotechnology company. We highly value experience in translating academic ideas into real-world products.
• Molecular Diagnostics Expertise: Proven experience in building real-world solutions in the biotechnology sector, particularly in single molecule detection and instrumentation for molecular diagnostics.
• Electrochemical Sensing: experience with electrochemical systems and biosensors.
• Biochemistry: familiarity with the principles of biochemistry.
• Proven track record of scientific accomplishment/patent filings
• Soft skills: highly motivated and passionate about developing new technologies and products; strong documentation, oral and interpersonal skills, experience working in a multidisciplinary team.
This is a U.S. based position, domestic relocation and local sponsorship considered on a per candidate basis.
The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $170,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your Recruiter can share more details about the specific salary range for this position during the interview process.
In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.
*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

title: Software Engineer AI Tooling
description:
## About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
## About the Role
Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.
You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.
## What Youâll Be Responsible For
Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.
Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.
Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.
Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.
Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.
Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.
Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.
Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.
Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.
Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.
Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.
## You Might Be a Good Fit If You
## Must have:
Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.
Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.
Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.
Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.
Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.
Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.
Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.
Know Postgres and relational database practice.
Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.
## Nice to have:
Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.
Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.
Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.
Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.
Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.
Experience across several product surfaces or teams.
## What We Offer
Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
ESOP
Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
Health Benefits
Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
## About the Team
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
~400 team members
60+ countries
20+ languages spoken
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

The Geospatial Data Science (GDS) team within the Strategic Energy Analysis Center at the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) is seeking a 6–12-month intern to support modeling and analysis. The GDS group conducts research at the intersection of energy deployment, big data science, and geospatial modeling and visualization. Our team of researchers develops and applies geospatial algorithms and methods to evaluate the deployment potential for energy technologies, including geothermal, hydropower, transmission, bioenergy, wind, and solar. title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a proactive, hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams. In this role, you will be the "North Star" for secure cloud configuration, moving beyond simple alert triaging to building sustainable security foundations. You will bridge the gap between high-level security architecture and daily engineering execution, ensuring our AWS and Azure environments are resilient, compliant, and automated.
## WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Cloud Governance & Guardrails: Lead the deployment and optimization of AWS Control Tower, Security Hub, and AWS WAF to establish a secure multi-account strategy.
Cloud Security Platform Ownership: Own cloud security outcomes across AWS (primary), Azure (secondary), and limited GCP, including secure landing zone standards, guardrails-as-code, detection coverage, and remediation automation.
Secure-by-Default Engineering: Design and implement reusable, secure-by-default cloud patterns that allow engineering teams to deploy safely without constant security intervention. Establish hardened Terraform modules, reference architectures, and baseline configurations so the secure path becomes the easiest path for teams building in AWS.
Container Security: Collaborate with the AppSec Architect to secure EKS and ECS environments, focusing on runtime protection, image scanning, and least-privilege orchestration.
Security Assessment & Roadmap: Perform a comprehensive baseline assessment of the current cloud environment to identify gaps and provide actionable, prioritized recommendations.
Identity & Access Management: Lead design and enforcement of least-privilege IAM architecture across AWS accounts and workloads.
Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain secure configuration standards, documentation, and operational procedures that enable engineering teams to consistently deploy and operate cloud services securely.
Detection & Telemetry Ownership: Partner with security operations to ensure security telemetry from AWS environments is complete, centralized, and actionable (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow logs, etc.)
Cloud Security & Compliance Alignment: Ensure cloud configurations and controls align with internal security standards and external compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.). Partner with Security and GRC teams to implement audit-ready controls, automate evidence collection where possible, and maintain clear documentation of cloud security control coverage.
Third-Party Integration: Manage secure access and configuration for security vendor tools (vulnerability scanners, assessment platforms, etc.) within the cloud environment.
Incident Response: Participate in an on-call rotation for one week at a time and serve as primary SME for cloud security incidents (IAM compromise, exposed keys, misconfigurations, etc.).
Vulnerability & Exposure Management: Build and run the cloud vulnerability management program for AWS and Azure workloads, container images, and base AMIs. Define severity-based SLAs, implement scalable scanning and patch workflows (e.g., AWS Inspector, ECR scanning, hardened base images), and partner with Engineering to reduce exploitable exposure.
Cloud Security Tooling Ownership: Own onboarding, coverage validation, and tuning of CSPM and MDR integrations across AWS, Azure and GCP. Drive measurable improvement in signal quality, alert fidelity, and remediation workflows through automation and engineering partnerships.
Secrets, Keys, and Credential Hygiene: Design and enforce secure secrets management patterns (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store/Vault), automated rotation, and least-privilege secret access. Own KMS key strategy and governance (key policies, grants, rotation, separation of duties) and ensure no long-lived credentials in CI/CD.
CI/CD and Supply Chain Security: Secure the software delivery pipeline end-to-end, including identity federation for CI/CD, policy-as-code enforcement for Terraform and Kubernetes, artifact integrity controls (signing/provenance), and secure dependency/source controls. Ensure security guardrails are automated and developer-friendly.
Cloud Incident Readiness & Exercises: Build cloud-native incident playbooks (IAM compromise, crypto-mining, data exposure, suspicious network activity) and run periodic tabletop exercises. Ensure forensics readiness through log retention standards, immutable/auditable logging where appropriate, snapshot/containment procedures, and break-glass access controls.
Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Baselines: Establish minimum viable security baselines for Azure and GCP (identity, logging, storage, network, key management) and ensure telemetry parity into centralized detection. Partner with operation teams to secure hybrid connectivity with data center environments (segmentation, identity boundaries, secure administrative access).
Security Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Define and report on key cloud security metrics (coverage, misconfiguration trends, MTTR, control adoption, vulnerability SLAs). Use metrics to prioritize work, demonstrate risk reduction, and drive engineering alignment.
Leadership and Execution: Mentor other engineers and raise baseline security literacy in platform/DevOps teams through patterns, reviews, and internal enablement.
## WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
5–8+ years of experience in Information Security, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on AWS Cloud Security.
AWS Deep Dive: Deep hands-on experience designing and securing AWS environments, core services (IAM, VPC, S3, KMS) and security-specific services (GuardDuty, Inspector, Config).
IaC Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.
Containerization: Proven experience securing containerized workloads in EKS or ECS.
Azure Knowledge: Willingness to provide basic security support/maintenance for an existing Azure environment (Deep expertise not required; AWS is the priority).
Consultative Mindset: Ability to assess a complex environment and provide a "roadmap to green" rather than just identifying problems.
Collaborative Partnership: Ability to work side-by-side with engineers, speaking their language and helping them solve problems rather than just "blocking" tickets.
Strategic Documentation: Capability to translate technical configurations into clear, repeatable processes and procedures.
Automation First: A drive to automate manual security tasks to increase efficiency and reduce human error.
Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
Industry certifications such as Azure security certification, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or related are highly desirable.

We are looking for a Data & AI Delivery Leader to help expand the Data and AI Practice. This leader will be responsible for business development, client relationship management, solution architecture, and thought leadership, with a strong emphasis on high-quality delivery and practice growth. The ideal candidate will bring client credibility, a strong network of industry contacts, and a comprehensive understanding of current analytics and digital trends affecting the healthcare ecosystem. This individual should have a demonstrated history of delivering high-quality work and building ongoing, trust-based relationships with the C-suite of major providers (health systems, academic medical centers, and hospitals). Experience with payers and other sectors of the broader healthcare industry is also valuable.
Driven by the dynamic and evolving needs of the healthcare market, Impact Advisors anticipates significant growth for the Data and AI Practice. The Data & AI Delivery Leader will leverage the firm's existing data and analytics capabilities to extend services to a larger client base and more diverse market segments. This individual will enhance and help drive the current Go-to-Market (GTM) approach for new data products and analytics solutions. They will be hands-on, leading solution development and delivery while helping secure new accounts and expand existing business. Identifying and building the assets and accelerators needed to enable sales and delivery will be critical in this role. A strong understanding of the Epic Analytics Eco System and Azure Cloud technologies is essential. In addition, the individual should possess good knowledge of Data Science, Machine Learning, and Advanced Analytics applications and know how to position analytics and data-led transformation programs with clients.
This is a highly visible leadership role within the firm, with the opportunity to contribute to the future direction and growth of the Data and AI Practice. The individual must align with the firm’s philosophy of maintaining an extreme focus on quality of delivery, client satisfaction, and positive culture. This position represents a significant opportunity for an experienced healthcare consultant to play a key role in strengthening delivery capabilities, developing client relationships, and supporting the continued growth of the practice.
## Responsibilities
Business Development: Lead business development efforts resulting in $5M-10M+ annually in sales. Develop and manage both existing and new client relationships nationwide.
Delivery: Provide leadership and oversight for analytics engagements and teams, ensuring the quality, value, and successful execution of services delivered to clients. Establish delivery approaches, build and develop high-performing teams, and maintain strong client relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with leadership to establish market strategy and future direction for the Data and AI Practice, bringing practical delivery insight and a focus on scalable execution.
Developing IP & Thought Leadership: Stay informed about industry trends and competition to help grow the practice, create asset-based solutions, and develop differentiated thought leadership that sparks discussion. Participate in industry conferences and speaking engagements to enhance personal and firm reputation.
## Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree required.
• 10+ years of progressive experience in consulting and/or healthcare analytics, ideally serving providers (health systems, academic medical centers, and hospitals).
• Proficiency with cloud-based technologies, statistical and machine learning techniques, analytical programming languages, analytical libraries, and business intelligence tools.
• Natural leadership abilities, executive credibility, and the capacity to quickly build client trust.
• Demonstrated skills in collaboration, project management, problem-solving, and influencing.
• Genuine passion for and commitment to transforming healthcare delivery.
• Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character – demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior.
For salaried positions, this role may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus. Additional benefits and perks may also be available, depending on the position and employment terms. title: Data Scientist - Discovery Mode
description:
The Music Mission enables music creators to grow, engage, and monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artists and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos, and Clips help artists and their teams grow their audiences, connect with fans, and achieve their goals on Spotify.
We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode within the Music Mission. Discovery Mode is a tool for artists and music marketers designed to help find new listeners when it matters most. With Discovery Mode, artists and labels identify songs that are a priority, and our systems use that signal to inform the algorithms that power personalized recommendations. This role sits within the ML squad that builds and operates the models behind Discovery Mode's measurement system, and you'll serve as the squad's analytical lead.
In this role, you'll partner closely with product managers and ML engineers to evaluate and improve the models that power Discovery Mode. You'll tackle complex analytical problems by designing experiments, developing evaluation frameworks, and building the analytical foundations that help keep our models accurate, reliable, and impactful for artists. As part of the Product Insights team within Music Mission, you'll help shape the measurement systems behind one of Spotify's most important promotion products.
## What You'll Do
• Own the analytical function for the Discovery Mode ML squad, driving evaluation and continuous improvement of the models that power measurement and campaign optimization
• Partner with ML engineers to develop evaluation frameworks and identify opportunities to improve model performance, reliability, and customer impact
• Design and execute rigorous experiments to evaluate model quality, measure outcomes, and guide model development
• Conduct deep-dive analyses to assess model performance and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders
• Build, maintain, and evolve dashboards that track model health, customer metrics, and program performance
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to align analytical priorities with squad goals and customer needs
• Contribute to the broader Product Insights community by sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for analytics across Discovery Mode
## Who You Are
• You have 4+ years of experience in a data science role and a degree in data science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
• You have experience measuring customer outcomes, defining KPIs, and connecting analytical insights to product decisions
• You know how to design and implement A/B tests, understand when experimentation is the right tool, and interpret results with appropriate rigor
• You have experience evaluating machine learning model performance and partnering with ML engineers to improve model and customer outcomes
• You are comfortable working in a highly technical environment and collaborating closely with engineering partners
• You communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
• You have strong data science fundamentals, including Python, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, data storytelling, and experience working within cross-functional product teams
• You have experience in areas such as advertising measurement, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference at scale
## Where You'll Be
• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EST timezone region as long as we have a work location.
• This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
The United States base range for this position is $116,994 - $167,135 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of low-code proof of concepts (POCs), agents and other artifacts that facilitate:
• Be able to analyze client’s current state by assessing processes, technology tools and organizational structure with an intent to transform to a data and AI insight driven future state.

title: SQL Developer
description:
## About the Job
## Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!
At Ovation Healthcare, we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.
The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.
We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.
Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .
## Summary:
Ovation Healthcare is hiring a mid-level MSSQL Developer / DBA to develop, support and maintain the SQL Server and Azure SQL databases and ETL pipelines that power our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations. You will write and tune T-SQL, build and support ETL pipelines, handle day-to-day database administration, resolve production issues, support enterprise reporting, and help migrate legacy ETL workflows to Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
You will work alongside senior engineers who set standards and handle top-tier escalations, while owning assigned databases, tickets and changes end to end. The right candidate brings a careful, "first-time right" approach to production changes, always prepares a rollback plan, and asks the right questions to turn incomplete requests into clear requirements. You will handle healthcare data (PHI/PII) under HIPAA requirements.
## Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design, write and maintain T-SQL stored procedures, functions, views and tables that support applications, ETL pipelines and reporting
• Build, maintain and troubleshoot ETL pipelines that extract, transform and load healthcare and financial data into SQL Server, including data validation, error handling and job scheduling
• Manage backups and restores, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, user access and permissions, and capacity monitoring across SQL Server and Azure SQL
• Diagnose and resolve performance issues, blocking, deadlocks, failed jobs and data inconsistencies; escalate complex issues to senior staff with a clear summary of findings
• Author, test, peer-review and execute production data scripts, with a rollback script prepared before every data modification or schema change
• Review execution plans, indexes and stored procedures to refactor inefficient T-SQL and prevent recurring issues
• Build, modify and troubleshoot SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports, subscriptions and underlying datasets
• Support the conversion of legacy ETL processes built on PowerShell and stored procedures into Microsoft Fabric and Azure, and provide operational support after migration
• Apply least-privilege access, protect PHI/PII under HIPAA, and follow team standards for source control, code review and change management in Azure DevOps; track work in JIRA
## Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• 3–5 years of hands-on MS SQL Server database development and administration in a production environment
• Strong T-SQL skills: set-based queries, stored procedures, functions, views, CTEs and transactional logic
• Experience writing parameterized dynamic SQL (sp_executesql) safely, and using WHILE loops and cursors for iterative and batch processing, with judgment on when a set-based approach is the better choice
• Proven experience building and supporting ETL pipelines that use SQL Server as the backend, including staging, transformation logic, incremental loads, data validation and failure recovery
• Working knowledge of database administration: backup/restore, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and permissions, and monitoring
• Solid understanding of explicit transaction management (BEGIN TRAN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), error handling (TRY...CATCH) and backout script patterns
• Experience using DMVs, Query Store, Extended Events and execution plans to troubleshoot performance issues
• Understanding of isolation levels, locking and blocking, and indexing strategies
• Experience with Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance
• Experience developing and supporting SSRS reports, including parameters and datasets
• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools: Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot
• Proficiency with SSMS, Azure Data Studio, Git-based version control and JIRA
• Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical findings in plain language to business partners
## Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with PowerShell scripting for database automation
• Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, Warehouses/Lakehouses) or Azure Data Factory
• Experience with high availability and disaster recovery (Always On availability groups, log shipping, geo-replication)
• Experience in healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management or another regulated industry handling PHI/PII
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300) or Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
• This is a remote position.
• Reliable high-speed internet connection is required for all remote/hybrid positions.
• Must have access to stable Wi-Fi with sufficient bandwidth to support video conferencing, cloud-based tools, and other online work-related activities.
• Collaboration in virtual settings and participation in team meetings.
• Ability to sit for extended periods at a desk and work on a computer.
• A HIPAA-compliant work environment is required, including a secure workspace free from unauthorized access or interruptions, no use of public Wi-Fi unless connected through a secure company-provided VPN, and compliance with all applicable HIPAA privacy and security regulations.
Travel Requirements:
• Dependent on business and client need

Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .
## What you’ll be part of:
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
## What you’ll be responsible for:
Circle has built its reputation on being compliant and transparent. That reputation rests on data that is right.
As a Data Engineer at Circle, you'll build and operate the pipelines and data models that our risk and compliance teams depend on to monitor activity, screen for risk, meet regulatory reporting requirements and produce evidence that stands up to scrutiny. You'll work with large-scale on-chain and internal data and turn it into datasets that people can trust, explain and defend. You'll join a team of passionate engineers who care about data reliability, learn from experienced senior and staff engineers, and take on a growing share of ownership as you go. If you pay close attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don't tie out, are excited to learn from our expert risk and compliance partners, and want to understand how our systems really work, we would love to talk to you.
## What you'll work on:
• Partner with product engineering, risk, compliance, data analytics and data science teams to understand what data they need and why, and help turn those needs into well-specified requirements, models, business logic and pipelines.
• Develop a working understanding of how the business thinks about risk and compliance obligations, such as transaction monitoring, sanctions and AML screening, regulatory reporting and audit evidence, and how our data supports each one.
• Own the pipelines and models you build, including on-call for them. Write and maintain runbooks, add data quality checks and alerting, and fix root causes rather than symptoms when something breaks.
• Work with on-chain data at scale, ingesting and modeling data from multiple blockchains and handling the realities of that data, such as reorgs, late or missing records and upstream schema changes.
• Deliver new sources, domain models and backfills with limited supervision. Escalate early on large or ambiguous efforts, and bring ideas for better approaches to your senior teammates.
• Apply access and control requirements correctly in your own work, such as authorized views and PII handling, and flag gaps you find.
• Build scalable automated solutions using SQL, Python, orchestration and transformation tooling, and AI.
• Review peers' code and models, document what you ship, and keep your partners informed on progress and risks.
## You will aspire to our four core values:
Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.
## What you’ll bring to Circle:
• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or similar), or equivalent experience.
• 3+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and models.
• Proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data stack: a cloud data warehouse, an orchestrator such as Airflow, and a transformation tool such as dbt.
• A track record of delivering well-scoped work independently, with high-quality, tested code and few errors.
• Clear communication and a collaborative approach, including the ability to explain to non-technical partners how the pipelines you build work.
• A strong sense of ownership: when a number looks wrong or a pipeline breaks, you dig in, find the root cause, and keep partners informed until it is fixed.
• Experience with blockchain data, financial services, risk, compliance, banking or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required.

description:
Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)
Remote job
About Recare
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.
What to expect as our Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d):
Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.
Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.
Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.
Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.
Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.
In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer
You'll help build Recare's Operator, our agent that gets AI-generated clinical output into hospital systems by operating their existing software the way a person would, no bespoke interface required. It's the sharp end of our integration strategy: a Windows desktop application that automates UI interactions with hospital systems, running on doctors' devices and often inside RDP or Citrix environments. The first version is already live – you'll help expand its capabilities and make it reliable in production.
You build and improve integrations between hospital systems and Recare products.
You implement and harden computer-use automation flows so they work reliably in production, including edge cases, recovery, and safety rails.
You partner with clinical domain experts to turn ambiguous workflows into shippable plans and robust implementations that solve real customers' needs.
You contribute across the stack as needed, including our Go-based gateway.
You invest in observability foundations (logs, metrics, traces) so we can trust the system in production.
How we work:
AI-native – our engineers reach for frontier coding agents every day to move fast across the whole stack, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.
Frontier models – we build on the best models available and adopt new capabilities as they ship, not a release later.
Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and validation loops that make that real.
Unglamorous foundations – engineers get the time to build the eval harnesses, guardrails, and observability that make AI trustworthy in production, not just the feature on top.
Ship and observe – always deployable, telemetry-driven, fix in the open.
Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer
You're a builder with a hacker mindset: you default to building rather than waiting, and you're solution-oriented rather than problem-oriented.
You have professional backend experience in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you can point to production software you shipped and owned.
You're comfortable working on integration-heavy systems: APIs, workflows, data models, auth, and real-world edge cases.
You're pragmatic about reliability: you care about monitoring, debugging, test coverage, and making systems operable.
You're excited to use AI coding agents daily and have opinions on how to use them effectively.
You're ambitious but frustration-tolerant. Hospital IT is complicated and progress is hard-won; you stay relentless, get your hands dirty, and iterate until it works.
You communicate confidently in English and collaborate well across Product, Engineering, and Operations.
Nice to have:
German language skills.
Experience with Electron or TypeScript on the desktop side.
Experience with healthcare IT systems (HIS, KIS, PVS, EMR) and interoperability standards such as HL7 v2 or FHIR.

title: Enterprise AI Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer !
## Missions
## 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots
En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :
ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids
c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle
Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.
C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :
une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises
l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc.
la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…
L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.
## 🚀 Tes responsabilités
Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe.
Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue
Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents)
Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio, en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise
Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur
## 🧭 Tes premiers chantiers
Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées…
Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension :

Observabilité : suivre les agents et leur performance, et améliorer chaque logique en continu
Autonomie : construire des workflows agentiques déclenchés par webhook ou planifiés, qui nettoient le contexte et mènent des missions 24/7
Très vite, tu as vocation à devenir le (la) responsable qui orchestre l'IA chez Alassio, et le (la) référent(e) de notre OS Bedrock.
## Profil recherché

## 💎 Qualités

Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
description:
## Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform Core
Location: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, Permanent
## About FullEnrich:
Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.
What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.
Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.
## About the Role:
At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.
We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.
This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.
We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.
If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.
## What You'll Do:
Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.
Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.
Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.
Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.
Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.
Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.
Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.
## What Success Looks Like
In your first 3 months:
Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.
Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.
By 6 months:
Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.
Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.
Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.
By 12 months:
Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.
Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.
Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.
## What We're Looking For:
Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.
An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.
Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.
Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.
Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.
A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.
Nice to Have
Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.
Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.
Familiarity with API-first product architectures.
An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.
## Our Tech Stack
Our backend is built primarily in Golang, following a modular, hexagonal architecture.
Our wider stack includes:
Backend: Go (Golang)
Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch
Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker
CI/CD: GitHub Actions
Monitoring & Observability: Grafana
You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.
## Interview Process
We aim to keep our process straightforward, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other.
Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.
CTO & VP Engineering Interview (60 minutes): A conversation about your experience, the role, and a technical discussion based on a real experiment.
Technical Assessment: A take-home exercise completed in your own time, followed by a review and discussion.
Team & Culture Interview: Meet with a member of the team to learn more about how we work together and ensure there's a strong mutual fit.
FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

## Key Responsibilities
DWH Platform Development
Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.
Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.
Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.
Team contributions
Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.
Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.
Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.
Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.
Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.
Data modeling
Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.
Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.
Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.
## Qualifications
Required:
Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.
Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.
Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.
Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.
Preferred:
Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage.
Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.
Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions.
## Perks
Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.
Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

title: Applied Scientist, Product Policy Research & Measurement
description:
About the Team

The Product Policy team develops and implements policies that shape how OpenAI’s technology is built and used. We work with teams across the company to turn complex questions about AI’s benefits and risks into practical guidance for responsible research, product development, and deployment.

About the Role

We are hiring a senior applied scientist to study how AI affects people and society using OpenAI production data, experiments, and social science methods. This role sits at the intersection of applied social science, AI, and product policy. The scientist will own research from an ambiguous question through study design, data collection and analysis, methodological validation, and recommendations. Their work will inform product and policy decisions and, where appropriate, contribute to external publications. We are looking for a hands-on empirical social scientist with exceptional methodological judgment.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop and execute a research agenda on AI’s social impact, including effects on well-being, learning, social connection, trust, and human decision-making, in partnership with product and policy teams.

 - Own empirical studies end to end: define the question and estimand, choose the design, build the dataset, conduct the analysis, and explain what the evidence supports.

 - Analyze large-scale production and behavioral data, linking them to experiments, surveys, or external outcomes when appropriate to measure real-world effects.

 - Design randomized experiments and credible observational studies; test identification assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish association from causal effects.

 - Develop and validate measures of social outcomes, including human and LLM-assisted annotations; assess measurement error, subgroup performance, and drift.

 - Translate findings into concrete product and policy recommendations, with clear limits on causal interpretation, generalizability, and decision confidence.

 - Partner with Product Policy, Research, Product, Data Science, Engineering, UXR, Legal, and domain experts; contribute rigorous work to external publications when appropriate.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A PhD or equivalent research experience in sociology, political science, psychology, communication, computational social science, or a related empirical field, with demonstrated independent research ownership.

 - Deep expertise in research design, causal inference, experimentation, statistical analysis, and measurement, demonstrated through work you can personally explain and defend.

 - Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with experience independently constructing and analyzing complex behavioral datasets and producing reproducible research.

 - A record of research that informs consequential decisions about technology and people, with the judgment to identify both useful findings and unresolved uncertainty.

 - Clear writing for technical and policy audiences, and experience producing rigorous research papers or equivalent public technical work.

 - The ability to move quickly, collaborate across functions, and maintain scientific independence when findings are sensitive or inconvenient.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Technical Agent Developer Intern | Open Position
description:
Vozy is a voice AI platform that helps companies to transform the way they interact with customers using contextual voice assistants and conversational AI.
Vozy is on a mission to transform the way companies interact with customers.
At Vozy, we are a diverse and talented team spread across 11 countries, and we are currently looking for a Technical Agent Developer Intern.
As aTechnical Agent Developer Intern you will join an innovative and multidisciplinary team to learn, collaborate, and contribute to the development of technological solutions that combine creativity, automation, and artificial intelligence, helping to continuously improve our products and processes.
## What you'll do
• Collaborate in the design and development of conversational agents using generative AI.
• Participate in the migration of conversational flows to new technologies.
• Support the automation of internal processes through RPA and intelligent agents.
• Contribute to API integration tasks and database management.

## What you'll need

• Languages: Familiarity with Python (Java or JavaScript is a plus). Experience using version control tools like Git.
• Interest in generative AI and prompting.
• Introductory knowledge of RPA and process automation.
• General understanding of software design and simple architectures.
• Knowledge of API integration and database use (both relational and non-relational).
• Familiarity with agile methodologies and collaborative tools.
• Curiosity and eagerness to learn in dynamic environments.
• Proactivity in researching and proposing solutions and Interest in innovation and continuous improvement.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Flexibility and adaptability to constant change and challenges.
Vozy Culture
At Vozy, transparency isn’t just a buzzword—it’s how we do things. We keep information flowing openly and honestly, making sure everyone is on the same page and working towards the same goals. Even in the fast-paced and ever-changing tech world, we never lose sight of the people who drive our growth.
We’re a fully remote team, our async tools let you manage your time in a way that works best for you, while our live meetings are all about connecting, making decisions, and moving forward together.
We’ve got some fun traditions too! We’re big on respecting everyone’s time, so if you’re more than a minute late, you’ll have to bust out a rap (or at least give it your best shot)!
## What we offer
• 100% remote internship.
